notes.title: Sparky Marky: Episode 2 IN EVERY LANGUAGE
notes.content:
Hi! 
We have a big update for you! And we also hasten to inform you that in the new update there will be localization into 8 languages! We really want every fan to be able to play the game in their native language! Enjoy it! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44180132/328fc30c4ef7a58264abe5cc3376751ddb808577.png

Update list:

- LOCALIZATION has been added: Spanish, Japanese, German, French, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese and Russian.
- Collisions have been fixed
- New evidence has been added to the room #8 and it was rearranged
- Materials of the cabinets have been replaced
- New cool posters have been added
- New ambient sounds have been added
- The size and complexity of the limb have been changed
- Final music have been added
- Final screens have been changed
- Saving of applications and tokens have been fixed
- Saving sound and graphics settings have been fixed
- The bug when a bullet from a stun gun got stuck in a player while running has been fixed
- Checkpoints that broke some saves have been fixed
- Saving audio/video settings in Esc Menu has been fixed
- The ability to control the character when the Esc Menu is open has been fixed
- The animation of healing in the standing/lying position has been fixed
- The position of the pistols in the hands after loading the save has been fixed

And many more minor changes and fixes

With love, team Clapperheads 💖

notes.title: Sparky Marky: Episode 1 VISUAL UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi! We have updated Sparky Marky Episode 1, improved the visual and now the gameplay is even more enjoyable and exciting! Thank you for staying with us! We appreciate it✨

[previewyoutube=pEfJQIRp7Yg;full][/previewyoutube]
Update list:
- The visual of the game was updated for the general visual of the universe
- A large number of bugs related to saves, settings and visual have been fixed

Play Sparky Marky: Episode 1 NOW!

Best,
Clapperheads team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Avaliable now

notes.title: ALPHA IS OPEN NOW! Playtest 3 + Guerilla Collective
notes.content:
Hey guys! We have great news today! We are participating in the GUERRILLA Collective! The first day of the festival starts today and in honor of this we are opening Playtest 3! 🤩 Play Sparky Marky online with your friends and share your feedback with us! And stay tuned! There's a lot of cool stuff ahead!

[previewyoutube=HnPLAxYA6t8;full][/previewyoutube]

To access it:
1. Go to our Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248290/Do_you_see_Sparky/

2. Scroll down and press on green DOWNLOAD DEMO button:
